text:
Jordan P: Heads-up — MeridianFinance wants to run a 2-week POC to replace CompetitorY. Main asks: API parity (especially prompt/response shape), billing comparison, and webhook retry semantics. Can SE/security triage? cc @Liang W @Priya M
Liang W: We need sample requests (top 200 call patterns) + a list of endpoints they use (streaming / completions / embeddings). Do they use role-based chat or simple prompt->response?
Jordan P: Mostly single-turn completion calls + embeddings for similarity search. A few streaming websockets for progress updates.
Priya M: Pricing question from their procurement: will Redwood provide a temporary flat-rate SKU for the POC? They want to avoid token billing surprises. We can offer a capped trial estimate — commercial can craft a short PO.
Helga Sec: Security checklist items: data residency EU (eu-west), SAML for admin console, audit log export weekly, webhook signing verification, and requirement for customer-managed keys (KMS) for at-rest encryption. Which deployment do they expect — Hosted or Dedicated?
Jordan P: They prefer hosted for speed but asked if Dedicated is necessary for KMS.
Helga Sec: Hosted supports signature verification for callbacks + IP allowlist; Dedicated/Private required for customer-managed KMS. I'll attach the mini-questionnaire template.
SupportBot: Note: Dedicated KMS integration requires enterprise plan + contract addendum. See https://redwood.example/ent/kms
Liang W: Proposed technical plan: 1) Kickoff & creds (day 0-1): share API keys, webhook URL, sample cURLs; 2) Parity run (day 2-4): run 500 promps through both systems and collect token counts + top-level diffs; 3) Billing smoke (day 5-6): replay recorded traffic to estimate token delta and per-run cost; 4) Scale test (day 7-8): traffic ramp to their p95 rps.
Liang W: Quick handshake examples to give their engineers:
```
# get token (example)
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/session -d '{"client_id":"MER-POC","client_secret":"..."}'
# call completion
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"model":"rw-medium-1","input":"Balance for acct 123 ?"}' https://api.redwood.example/v1/completions
# webhook validation header
X-RW-Signature: sha256=... (HMAC-SHA256)
```
Priya M: Acceptance criteria proposal: 1) semantic parity pass rate >= 90% on spot-checks, 2) token cost delta <= 20% for the POC workload, 3) p95 latency < 300ms for single-shot gen, 4) webhook delivery success >= 99% with retries.
Helga Sec: Also confirm TLS modes: Meridian asked for mTLS on callbacks. Hosted can do IP+signature; Dedicated supports mTLS. Flagging to sales that this may push them toward Dedicated.
Jordan P: Meridian procurement also asked about data deletion policy and audit timeline — please include standard DPA clauses and our SOC2 attestation link in the response.
SupportBot: Docs: SOC2 report (redacted) https://redwood.example/reports/soc2, DPA template https://redwood.example/legal/dpa
Liang W: For the parity tests we'll use automated metrics (ROUGE, exact match rate) + a 20-item human review for edge cases. Can someone from Meridian provide 200 anonymized prompts?
Priya M: I'll prepare a 2-week POC quote with a capped price and optional ramp clause. Prefer to get security thumbs-up before sending.
Helga Sec: I'll review the questionnaire and run a short threat model. Also need to know where Meridian will upload their questionnaire (SFTP or secure form).
Jordan P: Target kickoff Monday (4/12). Owners: Liang (tech), Priya (commercial), Helga (security). I'll ping Meridian for samples now. :rocket:
